items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: All of us just started to be messing that stuff... Freddie, he put a lot of stuff into him.

ctx.x: Who started adding all those notes?
Well, it came out long an hour time, you know. I see. Freddie, he put a lot of stuff into him. All of us just started to be messing that stuff, you know, putting more stuff into it.
Who was the best for that fast thing?
